process.title: Tell me what you're building
process.body: No brief required. A conversation about where you are and what's not working.

process.title: I map what's needed
process.body: Research, design and development, scoped around what you need. No bloated proposals, no wasted time.

process.title: We build and ship
process.body: Iteratively, with your team in the loop at every step. Things actually get done.

testimonials.name: Cleorise Enoch
testimonials.message: I asked Lulamile to sit with the people who actually use the app before touching the design. He did — and rebuilt the navigation around how they work, not how the org chart says they work. The search and grouped sections changed the way staff talk about the platform; the "where do I find" questions mostly stopped.

testimonials.name: Stanley Moloto
testimonials.message: We had the work, we just could not present it. Lulamile restructured the site around our portfolio and then set up the pipeline behind it. He was as comfortable in the copy as in the code, and proposals stopped being a scramble. Enquiries started arriving with context instead of a question mark.

testimonials.name: Gracious Mashasha
testimonials.message: We built the Nerdma site together and the handover never felt like a handover — the same component names, the same states, the same edges. He tests his own work on a phone before anyone else has to, and he asks the question that saves a rebuild two weeks later.

testimonials.name: Owner
testimonials.message: Orders used to come through messages all day. Now customers order themselves, reorder in a tap, and I change the menu from my phone. It just works.

testimonials.name: Gary Bannatyne
testimonials.message: I would have no hesitation recommending Lulamile for an extended internship or an intern developer role. He has acquired a technical foundation but would benefit greatly from the ability to further hone his skills before he becomes part of a development team.

testimonials.name: Ed Wrede
testimonials.message: Lulamile showed a good grasp of Java OOP principles, good database proficiency and a good grasp of Git and DVCS fundamentals. He was primarily involved with the implementation of the application from ideation and design through to the logic for his team's native Android app. He is good at design for mobile apps, and he assisted the web development team in coming up with intuitive designs.

testimonials.name: Bongani Dlamini
testimonials.message: Ambition — during his time at The Digital Academy, Lulamile displayed the desire to learn and improve his skills. Top three competencies: ambition, team player, communication.

about.intro: Your business deserves more than a good-looking screen. LulaZel brings design and development together to turn your ideas into websites, apps and connected systems that look right, work properly and support the way you do business.
paragraphs: LulaZel is an independent digital partner combining product design and development from the first conversation to the finished experience. The focus is simple: turn a business challenge into something useful, considered and ready to work in the real world.

Every project starts with your goals, not a template. Understanding your customers and the way your business operates shapes the journeys, interfaces and technology. Design and development move together, so the thinking behind the experience carries through into the finished product.

Behind the screen, the pieces need to connect. LulaZel brings together websites, online stores, custom business systems, automation and practical AI around the work you need to get done. Hosting is selected and configured with suitable providers; forms, bookings, payments and other integrations are scoped around your requirements.

One connected approach means fewer gaps between the idea, the design and the build. Clear scope, regular reviews, testing and a considered launch keep you involved without making you manage every technical detail. The result is a digital experience built to serve your customers and make your business easier to run.
about.close: Based in South Africa. Working with businesses worldwide. Your goals, your time zone, one connected approach.
